nvitk.gui.sge.poll
==================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.sge.poll

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

.. py:function:: read_done_marker(*, host: str, user: str, password: str, remote_job_root: str, port=22) -> nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeDoneMarker | None

   Return parsed ``output/.done`` when present, else ``None``.


.. py:class:: SgeJobMonitor(parent: qtpy.QtCore.QObject | None = None, interval_ms: int = 5000)

   Bases: :py:obj:`qtpy.QtCore.QObject`


   Background timer that polls ``output/.done`` for tracked GUI jobs.


   .. py:attribute:: job_finished


   .. py:attribute:: job_failed


   .. py:attribute:: _jobs
      :type:  dict[str, nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgePendingJob]


   .. py:attribute:: _timer


   .. py:method:: track(job: nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgePendingJob) -> None

      Start tracking *job* for completion, starting the poll timer if it's idle.



   .. py:method:: pending_jobs() -> list[nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgePendingJob]

      Currently tracked, not-yet-finished jobs.



   .. py:method:: _poll() -> None

      Check each tracked job's remote ``.done`` marker; emit ``job_finished``/``job_failed`` and
      stop tracking any job that has completed, stopping the timer once none remain.



.. py:function:: register_sge_monitor(app_state: dict[str, Any], *, on_finished=None, on_failed=None, parent: qtpy.QtCore.QObject | None = None) -> SgeJobMonitor

   Create or return the shared :class:`SgeJobMonitor` stored in *app_state*.


.. py:function:: shutdown_sge_monitor(app_state: dict[str, Any]) -> None

   Stop polling and block auto-import after the Napari window closes.


.. py:function:: store_pending_job(app_state: dict[str, Any], job: nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgePendingJob) -> None

   Persist a serialized snapshot of *job* into ``app_state["sge_pending_jobs"]`` (replacing any
   prior entry with the same job id) and remember the connection used, for session recovery.


.. py:function:: update_pending_job_status(app_state: dict[str, Any], job_id: str, *, status: str, done_payload=None, local_download_dir=None) -> None

   Update the stored status (and optionally done payload / local download dir) for the pending job
   matching *job_id* in ``app_state["sge_pending_jobs"]``.


.. py:function:: resolve_session_import(app_state: dict[str, Any], *, job_id=None) -> tuple[nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeConnection, str, str | None]

   Return ``(connection, remote_job_root, job_id)`` from the current GUI session.
